info.title: IM_Channel
info.description: An IM channel refers to the platform or medium through which a message is sent or received. In IM, a channel is created using configuration parameters, which are settings that can be adjusted to customize the behavior of the channel.

post.description:
Creates a new IM channel for the org. Required fields are name and integrationServiceId. Optional fields include configParams (integration-specific credentials), meta, defaultBotId, isSandBox. If isSandBox is omitted, it defaults to false.

For WhatsApp production channels, obtain the PHONE_NUMBER value for configParams by calling GET /api/v1/im/integrationServices/WHATSAPP/details to list WABA accounts, then GET /api/v1/im/integrationServices/WHATSAPP/phonenumbers with query parameter wabaId to list phone numbers for the chosen WABA. If these APIs return no data, complete Facebook embedded signup from the Desk UI before retrying channel creation.

After creation, associate the channel with a Desk department using PATCH /api/v1/im/channels/id/department.

channelPreference.description: Admin preferences for an IM channel including routing, business hours, and ticket conversion settings.

updatedBy.description: Desk agent ID of the user who last updated these preferences.

businessHourEnabled.description: Whether business hours are enabled for this channel. When true, use businessHourId to select the configured schedule.

businessHourId.description: Business hour configuration ID when businessHourEnabled is true. Null when business hours are disabled.

allHandlingAgents.description: Desk agent IDs assigned as handling agents for chat routing on this channel.

autoTicketConvertInterval.description: Timer duration in minutes for converting chats into new tickets. When a customer responds to an existing conversation after this idle period, a new ticket is created automatically. Allowed range: 10 to 5760 minutes. Any interval in minutes within this range is accepted. Example intervals: NONE (set autoTicketConvert to false), 10min (10), 20min (20), 30min (30), 40min (40), 50min (50), 60min (60), 2hour (120), 3hour (180), 6hour (360), 9hour (540), 12hour (720), 18h (1080), 24h (1440), 2days (2880), 3days (4320), 4days (5760), always (-1 or "-1" for a single ticket without a timed interval).

autoTicketConvert.description: Enables the timer for converting chats into new tickets. When true, a new ticket is automatically created if the customer responds to an existing conversation after the duration set in autoTicketConvertInterval (minutes). Set to false to disable (NONE).

assignmentRuleEnabled.description: Whether chat routing is enabled. When true, incoming chats are assigned sequentially to handling agents in allHandlingAgents.

callsVisibility.description: Call visibility setting for the channel when supported by the integration.

callsEnabled.description: Whether calls are enabled for the channel when supported by the integration.

sessionAutocloseExpiry.description: Session auto-close expiry in seconds for inactive conversations. Configure per actor (AGENT or BOT) via the channel preferences API. Auto-closes inactive conversations after the specified period to improve team efficiency.
